Hi Elena / Ops team —

Thanks again for confirming the Nov 20 workshop at your Seattle office. I put together a short delivery plan and wanted to align on the onsite lead and the insurance/handling requirements so we can lock the courier window. Key points below: 

- Shipment contents (high level): demo rack (1), two laptops with preloaded demos, 150 branded notebooks, printed executive briefs (25), table signage, and small swag boxes. Full inventory attached (demo-rack-inventory.xlsx).
- Preferred delivery date: Nov 19 between 9:00–13:00 so we have time to stage and test equipment.
- Onsite lead: we need a single POC from Astra who can accept the crate and sign the chain-of-custody; please confirm name and cell.
- Insurance: Redwood will cover standard freight insurance but FastFreight needs a written exception for live-demo electronics. If Astra requires vendor-side insurance endorsements, please attach the spec.
- Access & loading: is there a receiving dock or should the courier deliver to reception? Any weight or elevator constraints we should know about?

Proposed next steps:
1) Astra confirms onsite lead + acceptance window by EOD today.
2) I coordinate quotes with FastFreight and confirm pickup schedule tomorrow morning.
3) Monica (cc'd) will arrange packing & labeling per Astra's instructions and include the packing manual.

Elena — if you can confirm the lead and whether dock access is available, we can proceed. If Nov 19 morning is unsuitable, suggest an alternate morning window.

Thanks,
Hiro Tanaka

Hi Hiro —

Thanks for the clear plan and the inventory. We can accept Nov 19 morning but need delivery after 10:00 (our board meeting runs until 9:30 and logistics team clears dock after 10). Receiving dock is available, but heads up: the freight elevator max load is 800 lb and width is 36 inches. The loading bay clearance is 10' high.

Onsite lead: Julia Moreno, Director of Partnerships — julia.moreno@astrahealth.com, mobile +1 (206) 555-4410. She will be onsite at 10:00 to meet the courier and sign documents.

Regarding insurance: our procurement requires a vendor insurance endorsement when high-value electronics exceed $30k. I'll attach a template; please confirm Redwood can provide that (we usually need it before courier pickup).

Also: can you confirm the power adapter kits and HDMI adapters are labeled and in a separate small box? Our AV team will want to test connections quickly.

Elena
